shortDescription: Create or remove a Port Mirroring session.

options.name: description
options.description: The description for the session.

options.name: destination_port
options.description: Destination port that received the mirrored packets. Also any port designated in the value of this property can not match the source port in any of the Distributed Port Mirroring session.

options.name: destination_vm
options.description: With this parameter it is possible, to add a NIC of a VM to a port mirroring session.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the session is enabled.

options.name: encapsulation_vlan_id
options.description: VLAN ID used to encapsulate the mirrored traffic.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: mirrored_packet_length
options.description: An integer that describes how much of each frame to mirror. If unset, all of the frame would be mirrored. Setting this property to a smaller value is useful when the consumer will look only at the headers. The value cannot be less than 60.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the session.

options.name: normal_traffic_allowed
options.description: Whether or not destination ports can send and receive "normal" traffic. Setting this to false will make mirror ports be used solely for mirroring and not double as normal access ports.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: The address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a hostname or a IP. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of the HTTP proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: sampling_rate
options.description: Sampling rate of the session. If its value is n, one of every n packets is mirrored. Valid values are between 1 to 65535.

options.name: session_type
options.description: Select the mirroring type. In V(encapsulatedRemoteMirrorSource) session, Distributed Ports can be used as source entities, and IP address can be used as destination entities. In V(remoteMirrorDest) session, VLAN IDs can be used as source entities, and Distributed Ports can be used as destination entities. In V(remoteMirrorSource) session, Distributed Ports can be used as source entities, and uplink ports name can be used as destination entities. In V(dvPortMirror) session, Distributed Ports can

options.name: source_port_received
options.description: Source port for which received packets are mirrored.

options.name: source_port_transmitted
options.description: Source port for which transmitted packets are mirrored.

options.name: source_vm_received
options.description: With this parameter it is possible, to add a NIC of a VM to a port mirroring session.

options.name: source_vm_transmitted
options.description: With this parameter it is possible, to add a NIC of a VM to a port mirroring session.

options.name: state
options.description: Create or remove the session.

options.name: strip_original_vlan
options.description: Whether to strip the original VLAN tag. If false, the original VLAN tag will be preserved on the mirrored traffic. If O(encapsulation_vlan_id) has been set and this property is V(false), the frames will be double tagged with the original VLAN ID as the inner tag.

options.name: switch
options.description: The name of the distributed vSwitch on which to add or remove the mirroring session.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.
